answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks bulk identity forgery. To claim a slot, an agent locks 60 POA and registers a cipher key as its identity; the deposit burns if the slot double-claims. A beacon audits 5% of slots each epoch, and an agent failing twice falls off the ridge: slot revoked, deposit burned. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 POA, all burned, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its full share, steady as a zephyr.
